name: EPIC 211812508
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 9.6 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211812508 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.562803 (16th-84th percentiles 9.174965-9.94106), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211812508: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5357.3315 +/- 58 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211812508 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5102.96875 (16th-84th percentiles 4967.070312-5234.296875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,103 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.03 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,357 K at its surface.
